rag.text:
Test: TC-6042 — Feature area- ExtPlatform- Security- Blocking link editing via Workflow status properties
Priority: Medium | Status: To Do | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-47 Feature area - Security
Labels: teamextplatform

Description:
The purpose of this test is to verify if the system correctly blocks link creation on the Gantt chart for tasks in a status that has been set to non-editable via Workflow properties. The test also validates whether the user receives a standard warning message when attempting to create such a link after clearing the cache.

Steps:
1. Create new boxName then navigate to Box Configuration -> Tasks -> Scope definition and add *projectName* to the Box scope
   Data: *boxName*: TC-6042 Box

*projektName*: TC-6042 Space
   Expected: Project is successfully added to the Box scope.
2. Go to *projectName* -> Project settings -> Workflows and click 'Edit' on the active workflow
   Data: *projectName:* TC-6042 Space
   Expected: Workflow editor is opened.
3. Select 'In progress' status, click 'Properties', add the specific Property Key and Value, then save
   Data: *Property Key*: {{jira.permission.link.denied}}



*Property Value*: [empty]
   Expected: Properties for 'In progress' status are defined.
4. Click 'Update workflow' to publish the changes
   Expected: Workflow is updated and saved.
5. Open Gantt module for the *boxName* and perform 'Clear cache'
   Data: *boxName*: TC-6042 Box
   Expected: Gantt module is loaded and cache is cleared
6. Attempt to create a link between a task in 'In progress' status and any other task
   Expected: A standard yellow warning message appears: "Insufficient permissions to perform this action".
